San Jose, CA

Onsite

TikTok is a short-form mobile video platform whose mission is to inspire creativity and bring joy. The Monetization client team develops innovative advertising products for the TikTok iOS app, focusing on feature delivery, stability, performance optimization, and high-quality user experiences. The role collaborates with product, design, backend, frontend, and other cross-functional teams to build and ship ad features.
